caveats: Experimental; requires Paseo >= 0.9.2 and a separately installed official DSH (dsh on PATH).
Install via the repo's install.sh: it creates the DSH paseo profile and links the stdio bridge the plugin needs.
Model routes live in ~/.dsh/profiles/paseo/cordis.patch.yml; a vision route must declare an image input modality.
Plugins and DSH tools are trusted, unsandboxed code.
macOS verified end to end; Linux and Windows untested.
